name: Operation & Operator wise Production & Wastage Report
query:
select 
    jc.name as "ID:Link/Job Card:100",
    jc.work_order as "Work Order:Link/Work Order:100",
    jc.posting_date as "Posting Date:Date/Posting date:100",
    jc.company as "Company:Link/Company:100",
    jc.operation as "Operation:Link/Operation:90",
    jc.production_item as "Production Item:Link/Item:90",
    jc.batch_no as "Batch:Link/Batch:80",
    jc.for_quantity as "Production Quantity:Data/Production Quantity:80",
    tl.employee as "Employee:Link/Employee:100",
    tl.employee_name as "Employee Name:Data:Employee Name:100",
    tl.pcs_completed as "Pcs Completed:Data:Pcs Completed:100",
    tl.completed_qty as "Completed Qty:Data:Completed Qty:100",
    tl.pcs_rejected as "Rejected Qty:Data:Rejected Qty:100",
    tl.empty_pouch as "Empty Pouch:Data:Empty Pouch:100",
    tl.extra_printed_foil_sealing as "Extra Printed Foil Sealing:Data:Extra Printed Foil Sealing:100",
    tl.extra_printed_folder as "Extra Printed Folder:Data:Extra Printed Folder:100"
    
from
	`tabJob Card` as jc join `tabJob Card Time Log` as tl on jc.name=tl.parent
where
    `jc`.posting_date>=%(from_date)s
    and `jc`.posting_date<=%(to_date)s
    and jc.docstatus=1
report_name: Operation & Operator wise Production & Wastage Report
